The morning supervisor recorded a detail about rest areas after reading your letter and asked that we reply with care and clarity. You wrote to express disappointment that the arrangements for your companion animal did not meet the standard you expected during your journey with Aurelia Skyways. We are sorry that this experience left you unsettled, because every traveler should feel confident that a companion animal will be treated with patience, dignity, and close attention.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes such concerns seriously. A senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions so that reports like yours are reviewed promptly and with proper care. In addition, our trained staff are expected to provide calm handling, clean resting spaces, and steady supervision throughout each stage of the trip. If any part of that care was missed, we regret it deeply.

We appreciate you bringing this matter to us, as feedback helps us improve the service we provide to travelers and their animals. Your concerns have been shared with the relevant team so that the circumstances can be reviewed and any needed correction can be considered. We also remind staff that each animal deserves patient attention, and that comfort should remain a priority from check-in to arrival.

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress caused. We value the trust you placed in Aurelia Skyways, and we understand how upsetting it can be when that trust is not fully honored. Our goal is to offer steady, respectful support to every traveler, whether they are accompanied by a pet or traveling on their own.

Thank you for writing to us and for giving us the opportunity to address your complaint. We remain committed to improving our service and to treating every companion animal with the respect it deserves.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
